broader_review_uses.material: TACITO试验是首个针对mRCC的FMT-RCT，填补了从回顾性关联到因果干预证据的空白。

broader_review_uses.purpose: 为综述中关于FMT标准化、质量控制及微生物组分析方法学的讨论提供具体实例。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 对比与反例：Akkermansia muciniphila/massiliensis的双重角色。
broader_review_uses.material: 研究发现获得A. massiliensis (SGB9228) 与较短PFS相关，这与以往许多研究中A. muciniphila作为生物标志物的正面作用形成对比或补充。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于讨论微生物标志物的复杂性和情境依赖性，避免简单化的“好菌/坏菌”二分法。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅适用于mRCC一线联合治疗场景；样本量小，主要终点未达显著性；供体来源单一。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了FMT干预对ICI疗效影响的直接临床证据。显示d-FMT可显著延长mRCC患者的中位PFS（HR=0.50），并在IMDC中/高危亚组中显著改善12个月PFS率。同时指出总体定植率与疗效无关，提示效应可能依赖于特定的菌群重构而非简单的丰度增加。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于支持“肠道菌群调节可增强ICI疗效”的论点，并强调不同肿瘤类型或风险分层下效应的异质性。可用于讨论FMT作为ICI增敏策略的临床潜力及其局限性（如主要终点未达标）。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 基于观察性关联，非因果证明；特定菌株的功能验证需在体外或动物模型中进一步确认；Akkermansia的作用存在争议（通常认为有益，此处特定株系可能有害或指示 dysbiosis）。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了介导效应的潜在微生物机制：1. 特定菌株的获得（如Blautia wexlerae）与良好预后相关；2. 特定菌株的丢失（如基线Ruminococcus bromii）或与有害菌（如Akkermansia massiliensis）的获得与较差预后相关；3. 总体菌群多样性增加和基线物种的大量置换可能是重塑微环境的关键。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于阐述“哪些具体的微生物特征或动态变化与ICI响应相关”。可作为机制层面的具体案例，说明并非所有菌群改变都有益，需关注特定菌株的功能属性（如SCFA产生、炎症调节）。

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文为综述提供了关于肠道微生物群如何具体调节实体瘤（特别是肾细胞癌）中免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗效的高质量RCT证据。其核心价值在于区分了“总体菌群改变/定植”与“特定菌株动态”对临床预后的不同影响，并指出了特定有益/有害菌株的作用，这有助于回答综述中关于机制特异性和菌群功能模块的问题。
scope_interpretation_cautions: 主要终点（12个月PFS率）未达到统计学显著性（P=0.053），尽管趋势明显，但不能宣称FMT在该终点上确证有效。
中位PFS的显著改善是次要终点，需谨慎解读其作为主要疗效证据的地位。
微生物组发现多为相关性分析，特别是特定菌株与预后的联系，需结合其他研究验证其因果性。
供体均为ICI完全缓解者，且主要来自单一供体，结果可能受供体特异性影响，外推至普通健康供体或混合供体时需验证。
未进行抗生素预处理，这可能影响了定植效率，与其他使用抗生素预处理的研究结果不可直接比较。
topic_handles: specific microbial taxa (Bifidobacterium, Blautia, Akkermansia, Ruminococcus)

study_summary_A.approach: 这是一项单中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的2a期临床试验。纳入符合一线帕博利珠单抗+阿昔替尼治疗资格的mRCC患者。排除近期使用抗生素、胃肠道疾病或自身免疫病史的患者。供体选自既往接受ICI治疗后达到长期完全缓解的mRCC患者。实验组（d-FMT）接受来自供体的粪便移植（首次结肠镜灌注，后续胶囊口服），对照组（p-FMT）接受安慰剂。主要终点为12个月PFS率；次要终点包括中位PFS、中位总生存期（OS）、客观缓解率（ORR）、安全性及微生物组变化。采用全基因组鸟枪法宏基因组测序分析菌群组成及菌株水平定植（DoSER）。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了首个针对mRCC患者的一线ICI联合治疗背景下，供体FMT干预的随机对照试验证据，证实了d-FMT在改善中位PFS方面的潜在疗效及安全性。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 样本量较小（N=45用于主要终点分析），导致主要终点未达统计显著性；多数粪便由单一供体提供，限制了结果的普适性；未进行抗生素预处理，可能影响定植效率；随访时间虽长但死亡事件数不足，OS结果尚不成熟。

key_findings.conditions: 意向治疗人群（ITT）及全分析集（FAS）
key_findings.finding: 主要终点12个月PFS率在d-FMT组（70%）高于p-FMT组（41%），但未达到预设的显著性阈值（P=0.053）。
次要终点中位PFS在d-FMT组显著长于p-FMT组（24.0个月 vs 9.0个月，HR=0.50, P=0.035）。ORR在d-FMT组为52%，p-FMT组为32%。

key_findings.conditions: 事后分析：IMDC中/高危预后患者
key_findings.finding: 在IMDC中位或不良预后亚组中，d-FMT的优势更明显，12个月PFS率差异具有统计学显著性（63% vs 27%, P=0.045），中位PFS分别为18.8个月 vs 5.1个月（P=0.033）。

key_findings.conditions: 微生物组分析：整体定植
key_findings.finding: d-FMT组显示出显著的供体菌株定植（DoSER持续升高），且α-多样性（Shannon指数）和β-多样性（Bray-Curtis距离）较基线显著增加。然而，总的供体菌株定植率（DoSER）高低与12个月PFS无显著关联。

key_findings.conditions: 微生物组分析：特定菌株动态
key_findings.finding: 特定菌株的获得或丢失与临床结局相关。第1周获得供体Blautia wexlerae菌株与较长的12个月PFS正相关；而获得Akkermansia massiliensis (SGB9228) 或与基线Ruminococcus bromii菌株的丢失负相关。此外，d-FMT组患者基线物种的丢失比例较高，且这种丢失在维持PFS>12个月的患者中更显著。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 鉴于肠道微生物群可能调节ICI疗效，且现有证据多来自回顾性研究或非RCT，本研究旨在通过严格的随机对照试验，验证针对mRCC患者，使用来自ICI完全缓解者的供体FMT作为辅助治疗，能否增强一线联合免疫治疗的临床获益。
study_summary_A.research_scope: 转移性肾细胞癌（mRCC）患者，一线接受帕博利珠单抗（pembrolizumab）联合阿昔替尼（axitinib）治疗。研究涉及供体粪便微生物移植（FMT）对临床疗效及肠道菌群组成的影响。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究是一项研究者发起的、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的2a期临床试验（TACITO试验），旨在评估从免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）完全缓解者中获取的供体粪便微生物移植（d-FMT）是否能改善初治转移性肾细胞癌（mRCC）患者在接受帕博利珠单抗+阿昔替尼联合治疗后的临床结局。主要终点为随机化后12个月的无进展生存率（PFS）。结果显示，虽然主要终点未达到统计学显著性（70% vs 41%，P=0.053），但次要终点中位PFS在d-FMT组显著延长（24.0个月 vs 9.0个月，HR=0.50, P=0.035）。微生物组分析证实了供体菌株的定植以及α和β多样性的增加，并发现特定菌株的获得或丢失与临床预后相关，而总定植率则无关。

Safety data indicates FMT was well-tolerated with no serious adverse events related to the procedure. Methodological details include donor screening (ICI complete responders), FMT manufacturing (colonoscopy + capsules), and lack of antibiotic preconditioning.
supplement_gap_material.outline_action: Report that current evidence includes Phase 2a RCTs (e.g., TACITO) showing signals of efficacy (improved median PFS) but failing primary endpoints in some analyses, with no Phase III data available in this material. Recommend maintaining the 'unmet' status for Phase III confirmation while citing Phase 2a data as the current state-of-the-art for microbiome intervention in ICI-treated mRCC.
supplement_gap_material.remaining_gap: The supplied material does not contain evidence of a completed, large-scale **Phase III** randomized controlled trial. The highest level of evidence provided here is Phase 2a. supplement_gap_material.useful_material: This study (TACITO trial) is an investigator-initiated, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled **phase 2a** clinical trial evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) in 50 randomized patients (45 in full analysis set) with metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC) receiving pembrolizumab plus axitinib. broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 用于说明该领域仍处于早期阶段，存在大量的理论推测和观察性研究，但缺乏高质量的干预性证据，这有助于解释为什么综述需要强调高质量RCT的重要性。
broader_review_uses.material: 文献景观分析显示，关于微生物群与ICI的研究中，综述和评论文章占比极高（PubMed 48.3%，Embase 27.0%），而前瞻性实验研究和随机试验极少（<2.5%）。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 提供领域背景和研究现状评估

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 可作为综述中讨论“如何评估此类新兴联合疗法的证据等级”或“处理非随机对照试验数据时的方法论挑战”的素材。
broader_review_uses.material: 描述了使用Jadad量表评估研究质量，以及当缺乏对照组时使用FDA公开数据进行基线比较的方法论尝试及其局限性。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 提供研究方法论的参考案例

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅限于已发表的3项小型临床试验；结论基于与FDA历史数据的间接比较，不能直接确立因果关系；主要针对黑色素瘤和肾细胞癌。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了具体的临床结局数据：在两项单臂研究中，FMT联合ICI的ORR与ICI单药的历史基准相当，无统计学显著差异；在一项RCT中，虽然数值上联合组优于对照组，但与历史对照相比存在矛盾，且整体统计检验不显著。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于回答“肠道微生物群调节是否提高了ICI在实体瘤中的疗效”这一问题。具体用于论证目前临床证据尚不充分，或者用于展示不同研究间结果的不一致性。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 该综述本身未深入探讨分子机制细节，而是侧重于研究设计和临床结果的关联；其关于机制的评论是基于对纳入研究的元评估。
facet_contributions.contribution: 指出了当前研究在机制探索上的局限性：多数研究主要关注安全性、微生物组成变化（如Bifidobacterium丰度）和免疫细胞亚群变化，而临床终点（ORR, PFS, OS）多为次要终点。同时强调了研究设计（如抗生素预处理、缺乏盲法）可能混淆机制与疗效的解释。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于讨论“哪些机制介导了这种效应”时，说明目前临床阶段的研究更多是描述性的（观察微生物/免疫变化），而非确证性的因果机制研究；可用于解释为何机制假说难以在临床层面得到验证。

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该综述提供了关于“肠道微生物群调节如何影响ICI疗效”这一问题的直接反面或谨慎视角证据。它不证明有效性，而是通过评估现有小规模临床试验的设计局限性和统计结果，表明在当前证据水平下，微生物群补充并未显示出超越标准ICI治疗的显著临床获益。这对于综述中讨论“现有临床证据的强度”、“研究设计的挑战”以及“为何机制明确但临床转化困难”至关重要。
scope_interpretation_cautions: 该综述的结论是‘没有显著差异’或‘证据有限’，而非‘无效’。它强调的是当前研究设计的不足导致无法确认疗效，而非微生物群绝对不起作用。
引用的FDA数据作为对照，虽指示相同肿瘤类型，但患者人群、入排标准和治疗方案可能存在差异，因此比较仅为假设生成性质，不能作为确证性证据。
纳入的研究样本量极小（N=10-30），统计效能低，任何阴性结果都不能排除微小但重要的临床获益。

study_summary_A.approach: 采用系统综述方法。首先进行文献景观分析，对前100条结果按研究类型分类以评估领域内研究设计分布。其次，针对干预性临床试验进行二次系统检索，纳入英文原始文章，排除观察性、回顾性及动物研究。数据提取包括患者人群、研究设计、质量和结局指标。使用Jadad量表评估受控试验的质量。对于无对照组的单臂试验，利用FDA公开数据作为基线比较器，通过卡方检验比较观察到的ORR与预期ORR的差异。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了关于微生物群调节剂联合ICI治疗早期临床试验设计缺陷的全面评估，揭示了该领域从理论热情到实证验证之间的差距。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 仅纳入3项研究，样本量极小；两项关键研究为单臂且无对照，依赖外部FDA数据进行间接比较，内部效度受限；未进行荟萃分析因研究异质性高。

key_findings.conditions: 针对接受pembrolizumab或nivolumab治疗的转移性黑色素瘤患者的两项单臂FMT试验

key_findings.conditions: 接受nivolumab-ipilimumab联合治疗伴或不伴益生菌CBM588的转移性肾细胞癌随机对照试验

chapter.title: 微生物组干预策略的临床转化现状

chapter_plan.reader_objective: 使读者清晰掌握当前微生物组干预策略（FMT、LBP、益生菌、饮食/代谢物）在实体瘤 ICI 治疗中的临床证据等级、核心试验设计特征、关键安全性发现及方法学局限；理解为何现有阳性信号尚未转化为指南推荐；明确缺乏 Phase III RCT 确证的关键缺口及未来标准化研究的设计方向。
chapter_plan.thesis: 肠道微生物组干预在实体瘤免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗中的临床转化仍处于早期探索阶段。尽管粪菌移植（FMT）、活体生物药（LBP）、益生菌及饮食/代谢物干预在多项 Phase I/II 试验中展现出恢复或增强抗肿瘤免疫的潜力，但现有证据高度依赖单臂设计、小样本队列及异质性极高的供体/菌株配方。截至 2026 年中，尚无已完成的 Phase III 随机对照试验确证其疗效；安全性信号（如双免背景下的严重 irAEs）与定植效率瓶颈进一步凸显了从观察性关联向因果性临床获益转化的鸿沟。本综述的核心论点是：微生物组干预具有明确的生物学合理性与早期临床信号，但其作为标准辅助疗法的地位需等待大规模、标准化、多中心 III 期 RCT 的确证，当前应严格区分概念验证信号与确证性疗效，并将资源优先投向供体筛选算法、菌株功能验证及代谢物定量标准化。

units.evidence_conditions_and_limits: 所有 FMT 数据均来源于 Phase I/II 单臂或小样本 RCT，存在选择偏倚与历史对照混杂。黑色素瘤队列中观察到较高的 3 级以上 irAEs（65%），提示双免背景下 FMT 可能放大免疫激活风险。供体均为单一或少量个体，外推至混合供体或健康人群需谨慎。
units.material_supported_relations_conditions_: FMT 的 ORR 提升（20%-80%）主要见于黑色素瘤与部分 NSCLC/RCC 队列，但在广泛进展的篮子试验中失效（MITRIC）。主要终点未达显著性（TACITO p=0.053）反映统计效能不足或效应量异质性。定植多为暂时性，长期维持需重复给药或预处理。
units.ordered_development: 按试验设计类型（单臂概念验证 vs. 随机对照）与肿瘤背景（黑色素瘤 vs. NSCLC/RCC/CRC）组织证据，对比不同给药途径（口服胶囊 vs. 结肠镜）与供体来源（健康人 vs. ICI 响应者）对客观缓解率（ORR）、无进展生存期（PFS）及免疫相关不良事件（irAEs）的影响，揭示疗效信号与毒性风险的并存现象。

paragraph_briefs.development: 对比 MIMic（P0577）与 FMT-LUMINate（P0583）的单臂设计结果，展示健康供体 FMT 在黑色素瘤和 NSCLC 初治人群中实现的高 ORR（65%-80%），并指出这些研究为后续随机试验提供了效应量估算依据。
paragraph_briefs.point: 确立 FMT 联合 ICI 的概念验证基础与早期阳性信号

paragraph_briefs.development: 对比 TACITO（P0602）在 mRCC 中的 Phase 2a RCT 结果（中位 PFS 24.0 vs 9.0 个月，HR=0.50，但主要终点 12 个月 PFS 率未达显著 p=0.053）与 MITRIC（P0578/P0590）在广泛耐药篮子试验中的阴性结果（ORR 0%），论证 FMT 并非普适性挽救疗法，其获益高度依赖基线免疫状态、疾病进展速度及供体匹配度。
paragraph_briefs.point: 揭示 FMT 疗效的肿瘤类型特异性与随机对照试验的复杂结果

paragraph_briefs.development: 比较 FMT-LUMINate（P0583）的口服胶囊递送与 TACITO（P0602）的结肠镜+胶囊组合在菌群定植（DoSER）与α/β多样性变化上的差异；分析 MITRIC（P0578）中供体粪便仅实现短暂定植且未能重塑外周髓系/淋巴细胞景观的现象，提示单次或有限次给药可能不足以克服深度失调。
paragraph_briefs.point: 阐明给药途径与供体来源对定植动力学及临床结局的修饰作用

units.evidence_conditions_and_limits: LBP 数据主要来自 Phase I/II 或会议摘要，缺乏长期随访。CBM588 的阳性结果来自单中心小样本 RCT，可能存在中心偏倚。商业益生菌的负面关联多为回顾性观察，混杂因素（如患者基线菌群、合并用药）未完全控制。GMP 标准与冷链物流限制全球可及性。
units.material_supported_relations_conditions_: LBP 的疗效信号高度依赖特定菌株的功能属性（如产丁酸、激活 STING/AhR）。CBM588 在 RCC 有效，但商业益生菌在其他队列中无效甚至有害。SER-401 失败证明预处理方案需精准匹配目标菌的定植需求。
units.ordered_development: 按产品复杂度（单菌株 LBP vs. 共培养生态系统疗法 vs. 商业益生菌）分类，评估其在 ICI 背景下的安全性、微生物组重塑能力及初步疗效信号，重点剖析 CBM588、MRx0518、MET4/MaaT034 及 SER-401 等候选产品的开发路径与失败教训。

paragraph_briefs.development: 阐述 MRx0518（P0125/P0230）在 ICI 耐药实体瘤中的 Part A 安全性通过情况及其基于 TLR5/NF-κB 通路的免疫调节假说；对比 MET4（P0552/P0242）与 MaaT034（P0473/P0522）共培养产品在无菌鼠模型中成功定植、产生 SCFA/吲哚/次级胆汁酸并改善肠道生理的体外/体内证据，强调其作为“后生元”替代方案的潜力。

paragraph_briefs.development: 引用 P0006/P0143/P0090 中 CBM588 联合 nivo/ipi 或 cabo/nivo 在 mRCC 中显著提升 ORR（58%-74%）与延长 PFS 的数据，同时对比 P0357/P0454/P0572 指出的非靶向商业益生菌补充剂可能与较低 ICI 响应率及较差 PFS 相关，论证菌株特异性与生态位竞争的重要性。

useful_material: This study (FMT-LUMINate) is a multicenter, open-label, phase 2 trial (NCT04951583) evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and melanoma. It reported an objective response rate (ORR) of 80% in NSCLC (n=20) and 75% in melanoma (n=20), exceeding historical controls. Mechanistically, the authors found that clinical response was associated with the depletion of baseline deleterious bacterial species (e.g., Enterocloster, Clostridium) rather than donor strain engraftment, a finding corroborated by mouse models and other published trials. Safety data indicated no grade 3+ adverse events (AEs) in the NSCLC cohort but a higher incidence of grade 3+ AEs (65%) and myocarditis (15%) in the melanoma cohort receiving dual ICI, linked to Prevotella-rich donors. The discussion mentions an ongoing randomized CanBiome2 trial (NCT06623461) and a concurrent TACITO trial that showed PFS improvement, but does not present completed Phase III results from these studies.

This study (TACITO trial) is an investigator-initiated, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2a trial evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) in 45 patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC) receiving first-line pembrolizumab plus axitinib. The intervention involved FMT from donors who achieved complete response to ICI, administered via colonoscopy and capsules. While the primary endpoint (12-month progression-free survival rate) was not statistically met (70% vs 41%, P=0.053), the secondary endpoint of median progression-free survival was significantly improved in the donor FMT arm (24.0 months vs 9.0 months, HR=0.50, P=0.035). The study confirmed donor strain engraftment and identified specific microbial strains (e.g., Blautia wexlerae acquisition, Akkermansia massiliensis avoidance) associated with clinical outcomes, providing mechanistic insights into microbiome-ICI interactions.

useful_material: 本研究（MITRIC 试验，NCT05286294）是一项单臂、IIa 期篮子试验，纳入 12 名对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）耐药的晚期癌症患者（主要为黑色素瘤，另有头颈鳞癌、肾细胞癌、胰腺癌各 1 例）。研究评估了来自 ICI 长期响应者的粪便微生物移植（FMT）联合 ICI 治疗的安全性和有效性。主要结果显示客观缓解率（ORR）为 0%（0/12），中位无进展生存期（PFS）为 1.5 个月，中位总生存期（OS）为 10.1 个月。仅 1 例黑色素瘤患者达到方案定义的临床获益（稳定疾病>6 个月）。安全性方面，FMT 耐受性良好，50% 患者发生免疫相关不良事件（irAEs），多为 1-2 级。研究还通过质谱流式细胞术分析了外周血免疫细胞，发现基线高分化 T 细胞特征与较好预后相关，而髓系优势环境与不良预后相关，且 FMT 未显著改变外周血免疫景观。

This study reports results from a Phase II trial (FMT-LUMINate, NCT04951583) involving 20 previously untreated patients with advanced melanoma receiving fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with dual immune checkpoint inhibitors (ipilimumab and nivolumab). The design was single-arm with safety as the primary endpoint. The authors observed an objective response rate (ORR) of 70% (2 complete responses, 12 partial responses), but also noted high rates of immune-related adverse events (65% grade >3, including 20% diarrhea/colitis and 2 cases of myocarditis). The conclusion states that these results support the study of FMT and immunotherapy in the randomized setting, indicating that definitive randomized evidence is not yet established by this work.

综述结论明确指出当前研究设计有限，缺乏随机、大样本、有对照的试验，未来需要此类试验来确定临床效果。
统计比较显示，现有小型试验的 ORR 与 FDA 历史单药数据无显著差异，提示目前证据不支持微生物组补充能显著提高 ICI 疗效。

This study (TACITO trial) is an investigator-initiated, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled **phase 2a** clinical trial evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) in 50 randomized patients (45 in full analysis set) with metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC) receiving pembrolizumab plus axitinib. The primary endpoint (12-month progression-free survival rate) was not met (P=0.053), though secondary endpoints showed significantly improved median PFS (24.0 vs 9.0 months, P=0.035) and objective response rate in the donor-FMT arm. The authors explicitly state this is the first RCT to investigate targeted FMT in mRCC with PFS/OS endpoints, positioning it as Phase 2a evidence rather than Phase III.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 在综述的'临床证据现状'或'未满足需求'部分，引用此荟萃分析作为核心依据，陈述目前微生物组干预（益生菌、FMT）在 ICI 治疗中缺乏 III 期 RCT 确证数据。具体引用其对 FMT 研究设计（主要为 I/II 期）和益生菌证据等级（早期试验/回顾性）的描述，以及其关于'需要更大规模、高质量研究验证'的结论，以支持'该领域仍处于 unmet 状态'的判断。同时，可利用其提供的早期试验效应量（如 FMT ORR 0.30，益生菌 HR 0.56）作为开展 III 期试验的合理性依据（rationale）。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 虽然该材料确认了截至 2026 年中旬尚无已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验发表主要结局数据（支持'unmet'状态），但材料本身并未排除 2026 年 6 月之后可能有新试验完成或正在进行的 III 期试验（如文中提及的 TACITO 试验为 II 期）。因此，关于'是否存在'的最终结论依赖于该综述的检索截止日期，需注明证据截止时间为 2026 年 6 月。
useful_material: The supplied text explicitly addresses the status of large-scale trials in the section 'Large-scale clinical evidence, meta-analytic synthesis, and long-term safety follow-up.' It states that 'as of late 2025, no completed Phase III randomized trials have yet confirmed a reproducible survival benefit of microbiome-based interventions in oncology.' The authors note that current evidence relies on Phase I/II trials (e.g., FMT studies in melanoma showing ~40% response rates in refractory patients) and meta-analyses of these smaller cohorts. The text details specific ongoing or completed early-phase trials, such as NCT03353402 and NCT03341143 for FMT, and Phase I trials for engineered live biotherapeutics like SYNB1891 and MRx0518. It also highlights a pooled analysis of eleven interventional studies (>800 patients) showing improved objective response rates but notes moderate heterogeneity. Furthermore, the text provides extensive mechanistic data on microbial metabolites (SCFAs, tryptophan derivatives, bile acids) and their context-dependent effects on immune cells (CD8+ T cells, Tregs), which serves as the biological rationale for why such Phase III trials are being pursued despite the current lack of definitive clinical proof.

该研究为截至 2026 年 6 月 15 日的系统综述与荟萃分析，纳入 106 项研究（76 项抗生素、15 项益生菌、15 项 FMT）。关于 FMT，作者明确指出纳入的研究设计'主要为 1/2 期临床试验或探索性研究，仅有少数采用随机对照设计（1 项）'，且未报告任何完成的 III 期试验主要结局数据。关于益生菌，纳入研究由'回顾性队列调查和前瞻性早期临床试验'组成，结论部分强调'当前证据仍不足以证明在前瞻性试验或选定研究环境之外常规实施的合理性'，并指出'需要在更大规模、高质量的研究中进一步验证'。关于抗生素，绝大多数为回顾性队列设计。作者搜索了 ClinicalTrials.gov 及 ASCO/ESMO 摘要，未发现已完成的 III 期 RCT 主要数据。

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this study to substantiate the claim that methodological standardization is currently a barrier in microbiome-metabolite research within the review's discussion on limitations. Continue searching for primary technical reports or consensus statements that specifically address quantification protocols for inosine and SCFAs in serum or tumor microenvironment, as this review only highlights the need for such protocols without providing them.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This material does not provide the specific standardized measurement protocols, absolute physiological concentration reference ranges, or consensus statements for inosine or short-chain fatty acids requested in the gap question. It confirms the general absence of standardization but does not name the specific metabolites of interest (inosine, SCFAs) or offer the stratified data (e.g., CheckMate 025 cohort details) required to fully satisfy the success criteria for specific quantification methods.
useful_material: This study explicitly identifies a 'lack of methodological standardization' as a primary challenge in the field, noting that this generates observational inconsistencies and complicates causal inference. The authors state that future progress depends on 'large-scale, longitudinal, multiomics clinical trials using harmonized protocols.' Additionally, the review distinguishes between systemic effects (gut-derived metabolites enhancing systemic immunotherapy) and local effects (urobiome interfering with intravesical treatment), providing a conceptual framework for where metabolite measurements might differ by compartment.

该综述明确指出短链脂肪酸（SCFAs：乙酸 C2、丙酸 C3、丁酸 C4）和肌苷（inosine）是关键的微生物代谢物功能标记，初步数据提示其预测价值可能优于单纯分类学标记。文中阐述了这些代谢物的免疫调节机制：通过促进树突状细胞成熟、CD8+ T 细胞启动、肿瘤微环境重塑及肠 - 肺轴通讯来增强抗肿瘤免疫。综述还提到功能性代谢通路（如 SCFA 生物合成通路丰度）的富集与生存期延长相关，且跨地理和饮食差异保持一致。

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 基于此材料确认标准化方法缺失的结论，下一步应检索专门针对微生物代谢物定量方法学的原始研究或技术指南，寻找是否有特定实验室或联盟（如 Microbiome Quality Control Project 等）发布的标准化操作流程。同时需检查是否有更新于本综述的共识声明或大型队列研究（如 CheckMate 025 后续分析）发布了分层参考数据。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 该材料确认了标准化测量方法尚未建立的状态，但未提供具体的标准化测量协议、参考范围或共识声明。关于肌苷和短链脂肪酸在人体肿瘤微环境或血清中的绝对生理浓度，缺乏具体的检测技术细节（如 LC-MS/MS 参数）、样本处理标准流程或公认的正常值范围。
useful_material: 该综述在第 6.3 节专门讨论了循环微生物 DNA 和微生物组衍生代谢物（包括短链脂肪酸 SCFAs 和肌苷 inosine）。文章指出，虽然实体瘤患者中较高的血浆 SCFAs 浓度与更长的无进展生存期相关，且临床前研究表明肌苷可增强检查点阻断反应，但这些标志物目前仍被视为探索性工具。作者明确说明，在建立标准化的前分析程序、污染控制、可重复的阈值、纵向采样框架以及前瞻性治疗交互测试之前，这些生物标志物不应作为验证的预测生物标志物。文章还列举了影响循环代谢物浓度的混杂因素，包括饮食、抗生素暴露、地理位置、合并症和宿主代谢。

该综述明确指出目前缺乏针对肌苷在结直肠癌（CRC）发展过程中空间分布的标准化临床测量研究，大部分数据来源于批量代谢组学分析（bulk metabolomic analysis），且无人研究纵向追踪肌苷水平。文中提到仅有一项混合实体瘤的 II 期临床试验使用了口服肌苷补充（0.2 g，每日三次），但未报告针对 CRC 亚组的内源性浓度测量协议或参考范围。此外，文章强调了肌苷在肠腔与组织间的空间重编程及在炎症 - 肿瘤轴上的时序功能变化，解释了为何单一浓度测量可能不足以反映其生理状态，间接支持了建立标准化测量方法的必要性及当前处于'partial'或缺失状态的判断。
该综述明确指出目前皮肤代谢组学缺乏大规模人群的临床验证和标准化方法（Section 6.1, 9）。
对比了不同分析平台的定量能力：NMR 可提供绝对定量（absolute quantitation），而 GC-MS 和 LC-MS 通常进行相对定量（relative quantification）（Section 5.1, 5.2, Table 5）。
提及肌苷（inosine）相关代谢物（次黄嘌呤 hypoxanthine、肌酸 creatine 等）在黑色素瘤细胞系中的检测，但未提供人体血清或肿瘤微环境的绝对浓度标准（Section 7.3）。
指出确定绝对浓度的困难在于样本量小、分析物浓度低及个体间变异性大（Section 9）。
列举了脂肪酸（如棕榈酸、月桂酸）在肿瘤组织中的富集情况，但未特指短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）的标准化测量协议（Section 7.1, 7.2）。

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this study to describe the technical methodology for SCFA quantification in serum within the review. Explicitly note that this protocol covers SCFAs but not inosine. Highlight the lack of TME-specific protocols and cancer-specific reference ranges as a limitation in current standardization. Search for additional literature specifically addressing inosine quantification and TME metabolite sampling.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This study does not provide a measurement protocol for inosine. It does not address sample preparation or quantification specifically for tumor microenvironment (TME) tissue, focusing only on serum and feces. The reference ranges cited are from a general metabolomics database (HMDB) rather than a cancer-specific consensus statement or standardized reference range for tumor patients. The success criterion regarding 'consensus statements' or 'reference ranges' for cancer contexts remains unmet.
useful_material: This study provides a detailed Basic Protocol 1 for quantifying 14 short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in human serum and feces using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). It specifies alkaline extraction (pH > 7) using sodium hydroxide, derivatization with MTBSTFA at 60 °C, and specific GC-MS parameters (e.g., oven temperature program, ion source settings). It includes a table of 14 SCFA standards with retention times and quantification masses. It references the Human Metabolomics Database (HMDB) for normal concentration ranges of acetic acid in human blood (26.8 to 64.2 μM). It outlines calibration curve requirements (R2 ≥ 0.95) and sample storage conditions (−80 °C for long-term).

该研究建立并验证了一种用于生物样本（牛血清和牛奶）中短链脂肪酸（SCFA）绝对定量的 LC-MS 方法。核心方案包括使用 3-硝基苯肼（3-NPH）进行衍生化，结合反相液相色谱 - 质谱（RP-LC-MS）分析。方法学验证显示其具有高灵敏度（大多数分析物 LOD ≤ 0.1 µmol/L）、准确性（加标回收率 84–115%）和重现性（RSD < 7%）。该研究证明了在复杂生物基质（含脂质干扰）中检测挥发性 SCFA 的技术可行性，并提供了具体的衍生化反应条件（30°C, 30 min）和色谱分离参数。

This study describes the application of UHPLC-MS/MS to quantify short-chain fatty acids (specifically butyrate) in mouse plasma and feces, and GC-MS for tumor tissue, reporting measurable concentration changes linked to anti-PD-L1 therapy outcomes in a syngeneic NKTCL mouse model.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Search for at least one additional study that compares antibiotic classes (e.g., beta-lactams vs. fluoroquinolones or glycopeptides) in patients receiving ICI to meet the success criteria. Verify if other studies support the finding that Vancomycin is uniquely detrimental compared to beta-lactams, or if there is inconsistency regarding beta-lactam safety. Synthesize the findings to determine if a specific 'safe' antibiotic class can be recommended or if the evidence remains too heterogeneous.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The success criteria requires at least 2 studies comparing different antibiotic classes, but this material represents only one study. Additionally, while this study compares specific agents (Vancomycin vs. Metronidazole/Piperacillin-Tazobactam), it does not explicitly frame the comparison as 'Beta-lactams vs. Fluoroquinolones' as highlighted in the gap question, though Piperacillin-Tazobactam is a beta-lactam combination. It remains unclear if the neutral effect of Piperacillin-Tazobactam generalizes to other beta-lactams or if the negative effect of Vancomycin is consistent across other tumor types beyond melanoma.
useful_material: This study analyzed 876 patients with stage IV melanoma receiving ICI therapy to evaluate the impact of antibiotic type on outcomes. While overall antibiotic exposure showed no significant association with Time to Treatment Discontinuation (TTD) or Overall Survival (OS), specific antibiotic analysis revealed distinct differences: Vancomycin exposure was associated with decreased TTD (HR = 1.26) and worse OS (HR = 1.79), whereas exposure to Metronidazole and Piperacillin-Tazobactam had no significant impact on TTD or OS. This provides direct comparative evidence that negative impacts on ICI efficacy may be specific to certain antibiotic types rather than a class-wide effect.

This study performed a class-specific analysis of antibiotic exposure (beta-lactams, carbapenems, vancomycin, anti-pseudomonas, anti-MRSA, anti-anaerobe) in 237 Hodgkin lymphoma patients receiving checkpoint inhibitor combinations prior to stem cell transplant. The authors reported that exposure to these specific antibiotic classes was not associated with inferior overall response rate, complete response, progression-free survival, or overall survival after adjustment for salvage line and regimen. This provides a concrete example of a study design that stratifies antibiotic exposure by class rather than treating all antibiotics as a single 'broad-spectrum' variable.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 在写作中引用该综述作为证据，说明抗生素类别特异性（特别是氟喹诺酮类的高风险）已有初步观察信号，但强调目前证据等级尚不足以确立明确的'安全类别'清单。可结合该材料提到的异质性（如黑色素瘤例外），论述在评估抗生素影响时需考虑肿瘤类型和宿主状态。后续需查找该综述纳入的原始研究全文，以确认具体有多少项研究进行了类别对比及其统计显著性，从而满足成功标准中关于研究数量的具体要求。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 虽然该材料指出氟喹诺酮类可能与更差生存率相关，但并未明确确认至少 2 项独立研究的具体对比数据细节，也未确定是否存在相对安全的特定抗生素类别（仅指出氟喹诺酮类风险较高）。成功标准中要求的'明确说明现有材料仅支持广谱抗生素整体效应'与此材料结论不完全一致，因为材料提示了类别差异的可能性但认为证据尚需定义。因此，关于不同类别间差异的显著性及安全类别的确定性仍未完全解决。
useful_material: 该研究为一项纳入 25 项研究（约 73,567 名患者）的系统综述，主要发现抗生素暴露（ICI 治疗前 30-60 天或期间）与多数实体瘤患者总生存期（OS）较差相关（HR 1.08-2.55）。针对抗生素类别特异性，综述指出多项原始研究提示不同类别抗生素的影响存在差异，其中氟喹诺酮类在部分分析中与比其他类别更差的生存率相关，表明可能存在类别特异性效应而非统一的抗生素风险。但 authors 同时结论认为仍需进一步前瞻性研究来定义具体的类别效应。

This study conducted a retrospective analysis of 142 multiple myeloma patients undergoing autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT) to evaluate the impact of antibiotic classes on survival outcomes. The authors reported that both fluoroquinolone and beta-lactam use were associated with decreased progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) in univariate analyses. However, in multivariate analysis, beta-lactam use remained a significant predictor of progression risk (HR-2.25), whereas fluoroquinolone treatment did not retain statistical significance for PFS or OS after adjustment. The study also identified infection severity (CTCAE grade) as an independent predictor of decreased survival.

This study directly compares the impact of different antibiotic classes on ICI efficacy in a retrospective cohort of 140 NSCLC patients treated with nivolumab. It reports that piperacillin/tazobactam (PTZ) was significantly associated with shorter overall survival (HR = 3.31) and progression-free survival (HR = 3.40), whereas fluoroquinolones and third-generation cephalosporins showed significant associations with overall survival primarily based on duration of therapy (e.g., fluoroquinolones <2 weeks HR = 4.85 for OS) but not consistently in multivariable analysis for PFS. The authors identified PTZ as a high-risk broad-spectrum antibiotic compared to other classes, providing specific hazard ratios and correlation data (DDD) for PTZ, glycopeptides, and fluoroquinolones.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Retrieve and analyze the primary human cohort studies cited in this review (references [38, 85, 86]) to check for subgroup analyses comparing antibiotic classes head-to-head. Search for additional observational studies or meta-analyses specifically designed to compare the magnitude of ICI efficacy reduction across different antibiotic classes.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The supplied text groups multiple antibiotic classes (beta-lactams, fluoroquinolones, macrolides) together as having a negative association with ICI efficacy but does not provide a direct statistical comparison between these classes to determine if one is significantly less harmful or 'relatively safe'. It does not explicitly state that existing literature is incapable of distinguishing class effects, though it implies the negative effect is general across common broad-spectrum agents.
useful_material: The review cites human cohort data indicating that antibiotic use prior to or during anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy is associated with shorter progression-free survival and overall survival.
Specific antibiotic classes mentioned in association with negative ICI outcomes include beta-lactams, fluoroquinolones, and macrolides.
The text notes that in metastatic renal cell carcinoma patients, users of beta-lactams and fluoroquinolones had lower objective response rates and progression-free survival relative to non-users.

Mechanistic context is provided: antibiotics (e.g., vancomycin, ampicillin, colistin, streptomycin) compromise anticancer effects in mouse models by depleting microbiota required for immune activation (e.g., Th1 response, CD8+ T cell activation).

该综述在'Effects of antibiotics'部分提及多项临床研究评估了抗生素暴露对 ICI 疗效的影响。其中一项纳入 249 例患者的研究指出，使用抗生素（包括β-内酰胺抑制剂、氟喹诺酮类或大环内酯类）在 PD-1/PD-L1 阻断治疗前 2 个月或后 1 个月内与较短的 PFS 和 OS 显著相关，但该研究将不同类别抗生素合并分析而非相互比较。另有两项回顾性研究分别显示抗生素暴露与 RCC 和 NSCLC 患者 ICI 疗效下降相关，但同样未区分抗生素类别。作者明确指出，在最大规模队列中，抗生素使用与 ICI 抵抗之间的关联是'一般预后关联还是因果联系'尚不明确。

该研究提供了 945 名接受 durvalumab 治疗患者的回顾性数据，报告了抗生素使用的类别分布（β-内酰胺类 51.3%，氟喹诺酮类 39.3%）及其与生存期的关联。主要发现是早期抗生素暴露（起始前后 30 天内）与总生存期（OS）缩短相关（7.2 vs 9.8 个月），而晚期暴露（>30 天）未显示负面影响甚至与 OS 改善相关。此外，研究包含一项小鼠实验，使用左氧氟沙星（氟喹诺酮类）在晚期给药时增强了抗 PD-L1 疗效。

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Cite this study as evidence that dietary intervention can improve ICI clinical outcomes in a randomized setting. Explicitly note that while the trial design intended to measure microbiome mediation, this specific report does not provide the microbiome data. Action required: Locate the companion publication or full trial report for NCT04645680 that details the primary microbiome outcomes to determine if specific microbial changes mediated the observed clinical benefits. If no such data exists, classify the evidence as interventional for efficacy but observational/mechanistic-unproven for the microbiome pathway.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The success criterion requires confirming a causal chain where diet changes the microbiome which directly improves ICI efficacy. While this study confirms the 'Diet -> ICI Efficacy' link in a randomized trial, the supplied text does not report the microbiome data (structure or function changes) required to establish the 'Diet -> Microbiome' link or the mediation analysis. The abstract explicitly notes it reports exploratory clinical outcomes while the primary microbiome objective is not detailed here. Therefore, the mechanistic causal chain remains unverified based solely on this material.
useful_material: This study conducted a proof-of-principle randomized trial (NCT04645680) in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB), comparing a fully controlled high-fiber diet intervention (HFDI, 30-50 g/d) against a healthy control diet (20 g/d). The authors reported exploratory clinical outcomes showing that in the combined neoadjuvant/unresectable cohort, median event-free survival (EFS) was significantly longer in the HFDI arm versus control (not reached vs 20 months, p = 0.03), and objective response rate (ORR) showed a favorable trend (77% vs 29%, p = 0.06). Any grade immune-related adverse events (IRAEs) were lower in the HFDI arm (71.4% vs 93.3%). This material provides direct evidence that a specific dietary pattern can be implemented via controlled feeding and is associated with improved clinical efficacy and toxicity profiles in an interventional setting.

This study conducted the Phase II Diet and Immune Effects Trial (DIET, NCT04645680), a randomized double-blinded dietary intervention in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). Patients were randomized (2:1) to a high fiber diet (30-50 g/d) versus a healthy control diet (20 g/d). The authors reported early results showing the intervention is feasible with promising improvements in treatment outcomes. While the primary human data focused on peripheral immune profiling (showing reduced circulating monocytes and increased effector-memory T cells in the high fiber arm), the study included translational human-to-mouse fecal microbiota transplant (FMT) studies. In these FMT experiments, mice receiving stool from patients post-high fiber intervention demonstrated improved ICB response compared to pre-intervention stool, suggesting microbiome-dependent benefits. The authors conclude that the high fiber diet mediates regulation of peripheral immunity during immunotherapy in a microbiome-dependent manner.

This study conducted a randomized, cross-over dietary intervention trial (BEWELL Study, NCT04267874) in which participants consumed black raspberry (BRB) nectar versus placebo. The authors reported a significant increase in the abundance of Lachnospiraceae in human stool following the BRB intervention. To assess the impact on immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) efficacy, participant stool samples (pre- and post-intervention) were transferred into tumor-bearing mouse models (MC38, CMT167) treated with anti-PD1. The study found that stool collected after the dietary intervention was associated with smaller tumor volumes in mice compared to pre-intervention stool, and specific Lachnospiraceae isolates supplemented into pre-intervention stool recapitulated this tumor suppression. This provides a human-derived dietary intervention linked to microbiome changes that functionally enhance ICI response in a preclinical model.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 在综述中引用此研究作为 NSCLC 背景下饮食与微生物组关联的关键观察性证据，明确区分其与干预性试验的证据等级差异。利用作者‘建议进行随机试验’的结论，佐证当前领域缺乏确证性干预数据的现状，并据此提出未来需要开展高纤维或其他特定饮食模式的随机对照试验（RCT）以验证因果机制。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 该材料为观察性研究，未实施饮食干预，无法证实饮食通过改变微生物组‘直接改善’ICI 疗效的因果链条。成功标准中要求的‘1 项人类饮食干预试验’在此材料中未找到，仅能确认该特定队列证据为观察性关联。

useful_material.content: 该研究为前瞻性观察性队列设计（n=147），通过饮食调查（DHQ-II）和宏基因组测序（n=69）分析了晚期 NSCLC 患者中饮食模式与 ICI 疗效（PFS）及微生物组的关联。研究发现高脂低淀粉饮食（类生酮）与 PFS 改善显著相关（多变量 HR 0.37），且富集特定共生菌（如 Ruminococcus lactaris）；而高淀粉/蔗糖饮食与预后较差及特定菌（如 Prevotella spp.）富集相关。作者明确指出当前结果为观察性关联，建议进行随机试验以确立因果关系。
useful_material.relevance: 直接提供了人类 ICI 队列中饮食 - 微生物组 - 疗效的观察性证据链，明确了当前证据等级为关联性而非因果性，支持‘现有证据仅为观察性关联’这一成功标准的判定。

useful_material.content: 该综述综合了 49 项研究，明确指出人类证据主要为观察性关联，尚未有对照试验确立因果关系。文中引用 Spencer 等（n=128）观察性研究显示高纤维摄入与 PFS 改善相关，但强调这是关联性而非因果性。
useful_material.relevance: 直接回应成功标准中'确认现有证据仅为观察性关联'的选项，明确人类 ICI 队列中饮食 - 微生物组 - 疗效的因果链条尚未通过干预试验证实。

useful_material.content: 文中列出多项正在进行的人类干预性临床试验（如 NCT04107168、NCT03643289、NCT05037825），旨在评估饮食操纵或益生元补充对微生物组及 ICI 疗效的影响，但指出这些试验结果尚未公布或处于招募阶段。
useful_material.relevance: 说明干预性研究正在开展中，但目前尚无已完成的干预试验数据支持因果链条，佐证了当前证据状态的局限性。

useful_material.content: 提及一项早期病例报告（2 例黑色素瘤患者使用卡姆卡姆益生元联合 nivolumab），显示治疗反应性改善，但文中明确标注其样本量极小（仅 2 例），仅作为提出可能性的依据，不足以确立因果结论。
useful_material.relevance: 提供了现有的早期干预信号，但通过文中的局限性说明，支持了'尚无确证干预研究'的判断。

useful_material: This study is a meta-analysis of 106 studies evaluating three categories of microbiota interventions (antibiotics, probiotics, and fecal microbiota transplantation) in cancer patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). The authors found that antibiotic exposure was associated with reduced objective response rate (ORR), shorter overall survival (OS), and shorter progression-free survival (PFS). In contrast, probiotic use was associated with improved ORR, OS, and PFS. FMT combined with ICIs achieved a pooled ORR of 0.30. These results quantitatively support the general concept that gut microbiota modulation influences ICI efficacy and survival outcomes in human cohorts.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this study to illustrate the feasibility of dietary modulation of specific taxa (Lachnospiraceae) in humans and the preclinical validation of their functional capacity to enhance ICI response. In the review, categorize this as evidence for 'mechanistic plausibility' or 'preclinical validation of human microbiome changes' rather than definitive clinical efficacy evidence. Explicitly note the distinction between human microbiome modulation and mouse efficacy readouts when discussing interventional evidence. Search for additional trials where the human participants themselves are receiving ICI therapy alongside the dietary intervention to fulfill the human efficacy criterion.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The success criterion requires evidence of improved ICI efficacy within the human intervention cohort itself. This study measures ICI efficacy only in mouse models receiving human stool transplants, not in the human participants who consumed the diet. The abstract does not state that the human participants were undergoing ICI treatment or that their clinical outcomes (e.g., tumor response, survival) were measured in relation to the diet. Therefore, the direct causal chain of Diet -> Microbiome -> Human ICI Efficacy remains unconfirmed by this material, leaving the gap question regarding human clinical outcomes unresolved.
useful_material: This study conducted a randomized, cross-over dietary intervention trial (BEWELL Study) in humans, administering black raspberry (BRB) nectar versus a matched placebo. The authors reported that the BRB intervention significantly increased the abundance of Lachnospiraceae in the human gut microbiome, with less physically active participants showing a greater increase. To assess the functional impact on immunotherapy, stool samples from participants (pre- and post-intervention) were transferred into tumor-bearing mouse models (mc38, CMT167) which were then treated with anti-PD1. The mice receiving post-BRB human stool exhibited smaller tumor volumes compared to those receiving pre-BRB stool. Additionally, culturing and supplementing a specific Lachnospiraceae isolate into pre-BRB stool recapitulated the improved response to ICB in the mouse model. This establishes a mechanistic chain where a specific human dietary intervention alters the microbiome, and that altered microbiome confers improved ICI efficacy in a preclinical model.
该综述综合了 49 项研究（机制、临床前、观察性和干预性），明确指出人类 ICI 治疗队列中关于饮食纤维干预的证据主要为观察性关联（如 Spencer 等报告的高纤维摄入与 PFS 改善相关，n=128，自报告数据），而非已完成的干预性因果链条验证。
文中列举了正在进行的干预性临床试验（如 NCT04107168, NCT03643289 等），旨在评估饮食操纵或益生元补充对微生物组和 ICI 疗效的影响，但表明这些数据尚未发布或不足以确立因果关系。
提及一项早期病例报告（2 例转移性黑色素瘤患者，nivolumab 联合卡姆卡姆益生元后获得缓解），但明确指出其样本量有限，仅作为正在进行试验的理由，不能确立队列层面的因果链条。
总结了微生物组介导的潜在机制（纤维发酵产生 SCFA、GPCR 信号、HDAC 抑制、DC 激活、CD8+ T 细胞 priming），为解释观察性关联提供了生物学合理性，但注明这些机制多源于临床前模型或非黑色素瘤癌症。

examples.conditions: 研究人群：NSCLC队列（n=20，一线治疗，PD-L1 TPS ≥ 50%，无既往抗PD-1暴露）；黑色素瘤队列（n=20，一线治疗，允许既往辅助抗PD-1但需停药>6个月）。干预措施：单次健康供体粪便微生物移植（FMT，口服胶囊）后紧接着启动ICI治疗。NSCLC组使用帕博利珠单抗（pembrolizumab）单药；黑色素瘤组使用纳武利尤单抗（nivolumab）联合伊匹木单抗（ipilimumab）。
examples.finding: 在NSCLC队列中，FMT联合抗PD-1治疗的客观缓解率（ORR）为80%（16/20），超过了预设的64%主要终点阈值。在黑色素瘤队列中，FMT联合抗PD-1加抗CTLA-4（双ICI）治疗的ORR为75%（15/20）。关于毒性信号，在黑色素瘤双ICI组中观察到严重不良事件（AEs）的发生率较高且起病更早：13名患者（65%）经历了3级或更高级别的AEs，其中腹泻或结肠炎是最常见的3级及以上AE（20%的患者），另有15%的患者出现心肌炎。严重毒性的中位起病时间为开始抗PD-1和抗CTLA-4治疗后40天，早于文献报道的60天。相比之下，NSCLC单药抗PD-1组无3级或以上AEs发生。
examples.use_in_review: 提供FMT联合免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）和黑色素瘤中的具体客观缓解率（ORR），以及双免疫检查点抑制剂（dual ICI）治疗下的毒性信号特征。

question_material.explanation: 该研究通过FMT-LUMINate II期临床试验评估了FMT联合ICI在两种不同癌症背景下的临床活性与安全性。结果显示，FMT显著提高了NSCLC患者对单药抗PD-1治疗的反应率（80%），并改善了黑色素瘤患者对双免疫检查点阻断（抗PD-1+抗CTLA-4）的反应率（75%）。然而，在黑色素瘤双ICI背景下，FMT联合治疗伴随着更高的免疫相关不良事件（irAEs）风险，特别是心肌炎和早期发作的严重毒性。这种毒性信号与特定供体来源的微生物群（富含Prevotella spp.）有关，且仅在双ICI背景下出现，而在单药抗PD-1背景下未观察到类似毒性。这表明FMT的安全性与特定的ICI治疗方案及供体微生物特征存在交互作用。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为52名接受抗PD-1 ICI治疗的实体瘤患者；测量指标为粪便中的短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）及血清异戊酸水平。
examples.finding: 在52名接受抗PD-1免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗的实体瘤患者中，粪便中乙酸、丙酸、丁酸和戊酸的增加与更好的无进展生存期（PFS）相关（HR分别为0.29, 0.08, 0.31, 0.53）。血清异戊酸水平升高也与更好的预后相关（HR 0.38）。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供SCFAs在实体瘤抗PD-1治疗中促进疗效的临床关联证据。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为11名接受纳武利尤单抗（anti-PD-1）治疗的NSCLC患者；比较对象为治疗响应者与无响应者。
examples.finding: 在接受抗PD-1治疗的非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中，粪便中丙酸水平的显著升高与治疗响应者相关。血清代谢组学分析显示，乙酸、丁酸和丙酸的浓度与抗PD-1治疗的响应呈正相关，且与CD8+ T细胞上的PD-1表达呈正相关。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供SCFAs在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）抗PD-1治疗中促进疗效的临床关联证据。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为小鼠结直肠癌（CRC）模型；干预措施为补充丁酸或定植产丁酸菌；靶点为抗PD-1疗法。
examples.finding: 肠道菌Roseburia intestinalis产生的丁酸通过激活细胞毒性CD8+ T细胞，增强了结直肠癌（CRC）模型中抗PD-1疗法的疗效。具体表现为增加了CD8+ T细胞的浸润和活化，抑制了微卫星不稳定性高（MSI-high）CRC的肿瘤生长，并在微卫星稳定（MSS）CRC中与抗PD-1疗法协同作用以克服耐药性。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供丁酸通过特定机制增强抗PD-1疗效的机制研究案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为40名接受抗CTLA-4治疗的转移性黑色素瘤患者及小鼠模型；比较对象为不同血清SCFA水平；靶点为抗CTLA-4疗法。
examples.finding: 系统性短链脂肪酸限制了癌症宿主中CTLA-4阻断的抗肿瘤效果。在40名接受抗CTLA-4（伊匹木单抗）治疗的转移性黑色素瘤患者中，血清丁酸和丙酸水平与PFS和总生存期（OS）呈负相关。小鼠模型证实，口服丁酸降低了抗CTLA-4的疗效，并限制了T细胞上ICOS的上调和肿瘤特异性T细胞的积累。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供SCFAs对另一种ICI靶点（CTLA-4）产生双向调节作用（此处为抑制/负面效应）的案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为小鼠结肠癌模型；干预措施为口服异丁酸联合抗PD-1抗体。
examples.finding: 异丁酸（一种BCFA）增强了抗PD-1抗体在小鼠CT26结肠癌模型中的抗肿瘤效果。这种协同效应伴随着肿瘤内PD-1和IFN-γ水平的升高，以及CD3+ T细胞向肿瘤组织浸润的增加。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供支链脂肪酸（BCFA）增强抗PD-1疗效的案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为23名接受抗PD-1治疗的NSCLC患者；测量指标为治疗前后的血浆IDO活性和色氨酸水平。
examples.finding: 在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者队列中，血浆IDO（吲哚胺2,3-双加氧酶）活性升高与原发性免疫治疗耐药相关。进展性疾病患者的IDO活性在治疗后显著增加，而治疗响应者的IDO活性保持稳定。进展患者还表现出较高的血浆色氨酸水平。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供色氨酸衍生物（IDO活性）导致ICI耐药的临床关联证据。

examples.conditions: 研究对象包括黑色素瘤小鼠模型和42名黑色素瘤患者；干预措施为ICA补充或高色氨酸饮食；靶点为抗PD-L1/PD-1疗法。
examples.finding: 由益生菌Lactobacillus产生的吲哚-3-甲醛（ICA）改善了黑色素瘤小鼠模型的抗肿瘤免疫。口服ICA联合抗PD-L1治疗比单独使用抗PD-L1显著减少了肿瘤生长。机制上，ICA激活AHR通路，刺激CD8+ T细胞产生IFN-γ，从而增强ICI的有效性。富含色氨酸的饮食作为前体放大了这一效果。在42名接受抗PD-1和IFN-α治疗的黑色素瘤患者中，血清基线ICA水平在响应者中显著更高。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供色氨酸衍生物（ICA）增强抗PD-L1疗效的机制研究案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为结直肠癌小鼠模型及患者来源的类器官；机制涉及AHR和IDO1/Kynurenine通路的相互作用。
examples.finding: 由益生菌Lactobacillus gallinarum分泌的色氨酸衍生物吲哚-3-羧酸（I-3-CA）增强了微卫星不稳定（MC38）和稳定（CT26）结直肠癌小鼠模型中对抗PD-1疗法的反应。I-3-CA与犬尿氨酸竞争结合AHR。在CD4+ T细胞中，I-3-CA抵消了犬尿氨酸诱导的AHR激活及其向Treg细胞的分化。此外，I-3-CA降低了肿瘤微环境（TME）中IDO1的表达，减少了犬尿氨酸的产生，降低了Treg细胞的浸润，并增强了CD8+ T细胞的功能。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供色氨酸衍生物（I-3-CA）通过竞争性结合AHR增强抗PD-1疗效的机制研究案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为结直肠癌模型；关键代谢物为DCA；机制涉及Ca2+-NFAT2信号通路。
examples.finding: 肠道微生物修饰的胆汁酸（特别是脱氧胆酸DCA）通过抑制Ca2+-NFAT2信号传导来抑制CD8+ T细胞的效应功能。携带DCA生物合成基因的细菌存在与CD8+ T细胞活性降低和肿瘤生长增加相关。这种效应可以通过螯合、基因删除或噬菌体靶向DCA产生菌（Clostridium scindens）来逆转。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供胆汁酸（BA）抑制CD8+ T细胞功能并促进肿瘤生长的案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为接受ICI治疗的HCC患者及肝癌样本；比较对象为不同胆汁酸水平与T细胞反应及治疗响应的关系。
examples.finding: 在接受ICI治疗的不可切除肝细胞癌（HCC）患者中，响应者粪便样本中富集了熊去氧胆酸（UDCA）和鹅去氧胆酸。然而，在一项转化研究中，原发性和次级胆汁酸在肝癌样本中积累，高水平的胆汁酸与肿瘤特异性T细胞反应减弱和对抗PD-1疗法的耐药性相关。抑制胆汁酸结合酶增强了免疫疗法疗效。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供胆汁酸（UDCA）与肝细胞癌（HCC）抗PD-1治疗响应相关的临床关联证据。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为肝细胞癌模型；关注胆汁酸合成途径对T细胞功能的影响。
examples.finding: 胆汁酸合成阻碍了肝脏癌症期间的肿瘤特异性T细胞反应。高胆汁酸水平与抗PD-1疗法的耐药性相关。

question_material.explanation:
微生物代谢物在不同肿瘤类型和免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）靶点下表现出复杂的双向调节作用，其机制主要依赖于特定的受体信号通路和免疫细胞亚群的重编程。

1. **短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）的双向调节**：
   - **促进机制**：SCFAs（如丁酸、丙酸）通常通过激活G蛋白偶联受体（GPR41, GPR43, GPR109A）和作为组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂发挥作用。丁酸通过HDAC抑制促进Foxp3启动子区域的组蛋白H3乙酰化，诱导结肠调节性T细胞（Treg）分化，同时通过上调ID2介导的IL-12信号通路增强CD8+ T细胞的效应功能和记忆潜力。在抗PD-1/PD-L1治疗中，SCFAs通过促进抗原呈递和CD8+ T细胞浸润来提高疗效。
   - **抑制机制**：在某些情况下，SCFAs可能限制抗肿瘤免疫。例如，在抗CTLA-4治疗中，系统性SCFAs（如丁酸）可能通过扩大Treg细胞群体或限制ICOS的上调来抑制疗效。这表明SCFAs的作用取决于具体的ICI靶点（PD-1 vs CTLA-4）和肿瘤微环境背景。

2. **色氨酸衍生物的双向调节**：
   - **促炎/抗肿瘤机制**：微生物产生的吲哚类代谢物（如ICA、IPA、I-3-CA）主要作为芳烃受体（AHR）的配体。它们通过AHR信号通路刺激CD8+ T细胞产生IFN-γ，增强抗肿瘤免疫。I-3-CA还能通过与犬尿氨酸竞争结合AHR，拮抗犬尿氨酸诱导的Treg分化，并下调TME中的IDO1表达，从而减少免疫抑制。
   - **抗炎/促肿瘤机制**：宿主或微生物产生的犬尿氨酸（Kynurenine）是IDO酶的产物，它通过激活AHR诱导Treg分化和T细胞功能障碍，导致免疫逃逸和ICI耐药。因此，IDO活性升高通常与较差的治疗响应相关。

3. **胆汁酸（BAs）的双向调节**：
   - **促炎/抗肿瘤机制**：某些初级和次级胆汁酸（如CDCA、LCA）可通过激活TGR5受体增强I型干扰素（IFN-I）的表达，从而增强抗病毒和抗肿瘤免疫。UDCA作为FXR拮抗剂，在某些背景下（如allo-SCT）显示出保护作用。
   - **抑制/耐药机制**：微生物修饰的次级胆汁酸（如DCA、LCA）可通过多种机制促进耐药。DCA通过抑制Ca2+-NFAT2信号传导抑制CD8+ T细胞的效应功能。LCA及其衍生物可作为FXR配体，下调回肠血管中MAdCAM-1的表达，促使免疫抑制性Treg17细胞从肠道迁移至肿瘤和淋巴结，从而促进ICI耐药。在肝细胞癌中，高浓度的胆汁酸积累与肿瘤特异性T细胞反应减弱相关。

总体而言，代谢物的双向调节作用受限于ICI的类型（PD-1/CTLA-4）、肿瘤的组织学类型（如黑色素瘤、结直肠癌、肝癌）、代谢物的局部与全身分布以及宿主微生物组的组成。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为52名接受抗PD-1 ICI治疗的实体瘤患者；测量指标为粪便中的短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）及血清异戊酸水平。
examples.finding: 在52名接受抗PD-1免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗的实体瘤患者中，粪便中乙酸、丙酸、丁酸和戊酸的增加与更好的无进展生存期（PFS）相关（HR分别为0.29, 0.08, 0.31, 0.53）。血清异戊酸水平升高也与更好的预后相关（HR 0.38）。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供SCFAs在实体瘤抗PD-1治疗中促进疗效的临床关联证据。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为11名接受纳武利尤单抗（anti-PD-1）治疗的NSCLC患者；比较对象为治疗响应者与无响应者。
examples.finding: 在接受抗PD-1治疗的非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中，粪便中丙酸水平的显著升高与治疗响应者相关。血清代谢组学分析显示，乙酸、丁酸和丙酸的浓度与抗PD-1治疗的响应呈正相关，且与CD8+ T细胞上的PD-1表达呈正相关。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供SCFAs在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）抗PD-1治疗中促进疗效的临床关联证据。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为小鼠结直肠癌（CRC）模型；干预措施为补充丁酸或定植产丁酸菌；靶点为抗PD-1疗法。
examples.finding: 肠道菌Roseburia intestinalis产生的丁酸通过激活细胞毒性CD8+ T细胞，增强了结直肠癌（CRC）模型中抗PD-1疗法的疗效。具体表现为增加了CD8+ T细胞的浸润和活化，抑制了微卫星不稳定性高（MSI-high）CRC的肿瘤生长，并在微卫星稳定（MSS）CRC中与抗PD-1疗法协同作用以克服耐药性。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供丁酸通过特定机制增强抗PD-1疗效的机制研究案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为40名接受抗CTLA-4治疗的转移性黑色素瘤患者及小鼠模型；比较对象为不同血清SCFA水平；靶点为抗CTLA-4疗法。
examples.finding: 系统性短链脂肪酸限制了癌症宿主中CTLA-4阻断的抗肿瘤效果。在40名接受抗CTLA-4（伊匹木单抗）治疗的转移性黑色素瘤患者中，血清丁酸和丙酸水平与PFS和总生存期（OS）呈负相关。小鼠模型证实，口服丁酸降低了抗CTLA-4的疗效，并限制了T细胞上ICOS的上调和肿瘤特异性T细胞的积累。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供SCFAs对另一种ICI靶点（CTLA-4）产生双向调节作用（此处为抑制/负面效应）的案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为小鼠结肠癌模型；干预措施为口服异丁酸联合抗PD-1抗体。
examples.finding: 异丁酸（一种BCFA）增强了抗PD-1抗体在小鼠CT26结肠癌模型中的抗肿瘤效果。这种协同效应伴随着肿瘤内PD-1和IFN-γ水平的升高，以及CD3+ T细胞向肿瘤组织浸润的增加。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供支链脂肪酸（BCFA）增强抗PD-1疗效的案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为23名接受抗PD-1治疗的NSCLC患者；测量指标为治疗前后的血浆IDO活性和色氨酸水平。
examples.finding: 在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者队列中，血浆IDO（吲哚胺2,3-双加氧酶）活性升高与原发性免疫治疗耐药相关。进展性疾病患者的IDO活性在治疗后显著增加，而治疗响应者的IDO活性保持稳定。进展患者还表现出较高的血浆色氨酸水平。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供色氨酸衍生物（IDO活性）导致ICI耐药的临床关联证据。

examples.conditions: 研究对象包括黑色素瘤小鼠模型和42名黑色素瘤患者；干预措施为ICA补充或高色氨酸饮食；靶点为抗PD-L1/PD-1疗法。
examples.finding: 由益生菌Lactobacillus产生的吲哚-3-甲醛（ICA）改善了黑色素瘤小鼠模型的抗肿瘤免疫。口服ICA联合抗PD-L1治疗比单独使用抗PD-L1显著减少了肿瘤生长。机制上，ICA激活AHR通路，刺激CD8+ T细胞产生IFN-γ，从而增强ICI的有效性。富含色氨酸的饮食作为前体放大了这一效果。在42名接受抗PD-1和IFN-α治疗的黑色素瘤患者中，血清基线ICA水平在响应者中显著更高。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供色氨酸衍生物（ICA）增强抗PD-L1疗效的机制研究案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为结直肠癌小鼠模型及患者来源的类器官；机制涉及AHR和IDO1/Kynurenine通路的相互作用。
examples.finding: 由益生菌Lactobacillus gallinarum分泌的色氨酸衍生物吲哚-3-羧酸（I-3-CA）增强了微卫星不稳定（MC38）和稳定（CT26）结直肠癌小鼠模型中对抗PD-1疗法的反应。I-3-CA与犬尿氨酸竞争结合AHR。在CD4+ T细胞中，I-3-CA抵消了犬尿氨酸诱导的AHR激活及其向Treg细胞的分化。此外，I-3-CA降低了肿瘤微环境（TME）中IDO1的表达，减少了犬尿氨酸的产生，降低了Treg细胞的浸润，并增强了CD8+ T细胞的功能。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供色氨酸衍生物（I-3-CA）通过竞争性结合AHR增强抗PD-1疗效的机制研究案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为结直肠癌模型；关键代谢物为DCA；机制涉及Ca2+-NFAT2信号通路。
examples.finding: 肠道微生物修饰的胆汁酸（特别是脱氧胆酸DCA）通过抑制Ca2+-NFAT2信号传导来抑制CD8+ T细胞的效应功能。携带DCA生物合成基因的细菌存在与CD8+ T细胞活性降低和肿瘤生长增加相关。这种效应可以通过螯合、基因删除或噬菌体靶向DCA产生菌（Clostridium scindens）来逆转。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供胆汁酸（BA）抑制CD8+ T细胞功能并促进肿瘤生长的案例。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为接受ICI治疗的HCC患者及肝癌样本；比较对象为不同胆汁酸水平与T细胞反应及治疗响应的关系。
examples.finding: 在接受ICI治疗的不可切除肝细胞癌（HCC）患者中，响应者粪便样本中富集了熊去氧胆酸（UDCA）和鹅去氧胆酸。然而，在一项转化研究中，原发性和次级胆汁酸在肝癌样本中积累，高水平的胆汁酸与肿瘤特异性T细胞反应减弱和对抗PD-1疗法的耐药性相关。抑制胆汁酸结合酶增强了免疫疗法疗效。
examples.use_in_review: 直接材料：提供胆汁酸（UDCA）与肝细胞癌（HCC）抗PD-1治疗响应相关的临床关联证据。

examples.conditions: 研究对象为肝细胞癌模型；关注胆汁酸合成途径对T细胞功能的影响。
examples.finding: 胆汁酸合成阻碍了肝脏癌症期间的肿瘤特异性T细胞反应。高胆汁酸水平与抗PD-1疗法的耐药性相关。

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Search for trial registries or publications specifically labeled as 'Phase 3' involving microbiome modulation (diet, FMT, probiotics) in combination with ICI. Look for explicit mentions of 'CanBiome2' or similar large-scale interventions with reported primary endpoint completion dates. Use this study's data to contextualize the preliminary evidence base supporting the rationale for such Phase 3 trials, highlighting the specific clinical signals (EFS, IRAE reduction) that justify larger confirmatory studies.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The supplied material does not confirm the existence of a completed, large-scale randomized controlled Phase 3 trial with primary endpoint results (OS/PFS) for microbiome intervention in ICI-treated patients. This study is identified as a proof-of-principle trial explicitly calling for future Phase III research, rather than being a Phase 3 trial itself. Additionally, no information is provided regarding the expected completion time of ongoing key Phase 3 trials such as CanBiome2.
useful_material: This study conducted a proof-of-principle randomized trial (NCT04645680) with 45 melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade, comparing a high-fiber diet intervention (50g/d) against a control diet (20g/d). The authors reported exploratory clinical outcomes including event-free survival (EFS), objective response rate (ORR), and immune-related adverse events (IRAEs). Results indicated a significant EFS benefit in the combined neoadjuvant/unresectable cohort (p=0.03) and a trend in ORR (p=0.06), with lower IRAE rates in the intervention arm. The authors explicitly concluded that these findings warrant further study in Phase III trials powered for disease outcomes.

本研究（CONTACT-03）是一项已完成的 III 期随机对照试验，评估了在既往免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗进展后的转移性肾细胞癌患者中，在酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（cabozantinib）基础上加用抗 PD-L1 药物（atezolizumab） versus 单药治疗的疗效。研究结果显示，联合组并未改善无进展生存期（PFS）或总生存期（OS），且毒性增加。虽然该研究未涉及微生物组干预，但其作为 ICI 再挑战策略失败的阴性证据，支持了综述中关于‘现有临床策略在 ICI 耐药人群中效果有限’的背景论述，从而间接突显了探索非传统机制（如微生物组干预）的必要性。

This study analyzed access to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in patients randomized to the control arm across 8 international phase 3 trials for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) and urothelial carcinoma (UC). It found that approximately 57% of control arm patients in RCC trials and 59% in UC trials received subsequent therapy, with 67% and 75% of those subsequent therapies being ICIs, respectively. The authors noted significant variability between trials, with some showing low access rates (e.g., 40.5% in CheckMate 9ER, 33.5% in KEYNOTE-564).

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Report that no completed Phase III trials confirming survival benefits were found in this source, citing the explicit statement regarding the state of the field as of late 2025. Use the provided summaries of Phase I/II trials (FMT, engineered bacteria) to illustrate the current level of clinical evidence. Note the absence of specific details regarding the 'CanBiome2' trial in this text and indicate that further searching is required to find its projected timeline.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The specific success criterion regarding the confirmation of a completed Phase III RCT with primary endpoint results (OS/PFS) is not met, as the text explicitly states none exist as of late 2025. Furthermore, the text does not contain information about a specific trial named 'CanBiome2' nor its estimated completion time, leaving that part of the success criteria unanswered by this source.
useful_material: The supplied text explicitly addresses the status of Phase III trials in the section 'Large-scale clinical evidence, meta-analytic synthesis, and long-term safety follow-up.' It states: 'as of late 2025, no completed Phase III randomized trials have yet confirmed a reproducible survival benefit of microbiome-based interventions in oncology.' The authors note that current evidence relies on Phase I/II trials (e.g., FMT studies NCT03353402, NCT03341143) and meta-analyses. The text lists several ongoing early-phase trials for engineered microbes (e.g., SYNB1891, MRx0518, SER-401) but does not provide completion dates or specific details for a Phase III trial named 'CanBiome2'. It does, however, mention a dietary intervention trial (NCT04645680) and a multi-strain probiotic trial (NCT03829111) as ongoing or emerging, without specifying them as Phase III.

This study surveyed 29 clinical trials of microbiome modulators in colorectal cancer (CRC) as of June 30, 2025, finding that the pipeline is predominantly early-phase (Phase I, I/II, and II), with no mention of completed Phase 3 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) publishing primary endpoints like overall survival (OS) or progression-free survival (PFS). It reports efficacy data from Phase II trials (e.g., RENMIN-215 trial showing 20% ORR and 9.6 months mPFS with FMT plus ICIs in MSS CRC) and meta-analyses of early-phase trials, explicitly stating that 'the clinical pipeline for MMs in CRC remains predominantly early-phase'. This confirms the absence of completed large-scale Phase 3 evidence in the surveyed literature.

This study describes an investigator-initiated, randomized, phase II trial (NCT06030037) evaluating P+L versus P+L plus responder-derived fecal microbiota transplantation (R-FMT) in PD-1 resistant/refractory melanoma. The text specifies the intervention protocol: R-FMT is derived from donors with durable response (mPFS ≥24 months) following prior PD-1 ICI, screened for infectious agents, and administered via endoscopy on D1 and D42 followed by oral capsules. The primary endpoint is objective response rate (ORR) by Blinded Independent Central Review, with secondary endpoints including progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS). Translational endpoints include immune activation, metagenomic engraftment, and transcriptomic analyses. Enrollment has commenced, but no efficacy results are reported.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 建议直接检索 ClinicalTrials.gov 或 WHO ICTRP 数据库，使用关键词'microbiome'、'Phase 3'、'checkpoint inhibitor'及特定试验名（如'CanBiome'），以验证是否有该综述未覆盖的正在进行 III 期试验及其预计完成日期。同时需关注该综述发表后的最新会议摘要或新闻稿，以获取可能刚刚启动的 III 期项目信息。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 该材料未能确认具体的、正在进行中的关键 III 期试验（如成功标准中提到的 CanBiome2）的名称、试验设计细节或预计完成时间。虽然材料表明目前以早期试验为主，但未明确排除是否有未收录的 III 期试验正在运行，也未提供替代的 III 期试验时间表信息。
useful_material: This study is a narrative review of 95 clinical studies (2015–2025) evaluating the gut microbiome in cancer immunotherapy. The authors report that current evidence primarily consists of observational cohorts and early-phase interventional studies (e.g., Phase I/II trials of fecal microbiota transplantation in melanoma achieving 20–40% objective response rates). The GRADE assessment explicitly states that high-certainty evidence was not reached in any domain due to methodological heterogeneity, open-label designs, and reliance on observational cohorts. The authors emphasize the need for large-scale, multi-center randomized controlled trials to validate the microbiome's role but do not list specific ongoing key Phase 3 trials (such as CanBiome2) or provide estimated completion times.

该研究通过检索 Trialtrove 数据库（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日），分析了 29 项评估微生物组调节剂（MMs）治疗结直肠癌（CRC）的临床试验。结果显示，试验管线主要由早期阶段主导：II 期试验 9 项，I 期 7 项，I/II 期 7 项，未列出已完成的 III 期试验。文中具体引用了 RENMIN-215 试验（II 期）的数据，显示 FMT 联合免疫治疗在难治性 MSS mCRC 患者中取得 ORR 20%、mPFS 9.6 个月的结果。作者明确指出“虽然 MMs 在 CRC 中的临床管线仍 predominantly early-phase（主要为早期阶段）”，这直接回应了关于是否存在已完成 III 期试验的疑问（即目前尚无）。

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this study to support the methodology section regarding SCFA quantification in serum, specifically citing the alkaline extraction and GC-MS parameters. Conduct a targeted search for standardized quantification protocols for Inosine in biological fluids or tissue. Search for consensus guidelines or methodological papers specifically addressing metabolite measurement within the tumor microenvironment. Verify through broader reviews whether this SCFA protocol is referenced as a standard method in the field.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The supplied material does not provide a standardized measurement method for Inosine, which is explicitly requested in the gap question alongside SCFAs. Additionally, while the gap asks for methods applicable to the Tumor Microenvironment (TME) or serum, this study only validates the protocol for serum and feces, not TME tissue samples. The text presents a specific validated protocol but does not establish it as a field-wide consensus guideline or confirm its status as the universally adopted standard compared to other existing methods.
useful_material: This study describes a validated gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) protocol for the absolute quantification of 14 short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in human serum and fecal samples. The authors detail an alkaline extraction method (pH > 7) followed by derivatization with MTBSTFA, which allows for direct injection and sensitive detection. The protocol includes the use of chemical standards to construct calibration curves for calculating absolute concentrations (e.g., μM), and provides specific retention times and quantification masses for compounds including acetic, propionic, and butyric acid. The text references normal concentration ranges for SCFAs in human blood (e.g., acetic acid 26.8 to 64.2 μM) based on metabolomics databases.

该研究详细描述了一种用于血清和尿液中 10 种短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）及相关代谢物绝对定量的 GC-MS 检测方法，包括内标使用（甲基硬脂酸）、样品前处理（酸化、衍生化）、仪器参数及方法验证指标（线性、精密度、准确度、回收率）。研究明确指出采样时间标准化对 SCFA 浓度测量的重要性，因为昼夜波动的影响大于饮食干预的影响。这为血清中 SCFA 绝对浓度（μmol/L）的测量提供了具体的方法学参考和标准化采样时间的依据。

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Search specifically for validated LC-MS/MS or NMR protocols for inosine and SCFAs in serum or tissue samples. Look for consensus statements from metabolomics societies (e.g., MSI) regarding absolute quantification standards in blood/tissue. Compare urine-based validation parameters with existing serum method requirements to identify matrix-specific gaps (e.g., protein interference, stability).
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This study validates inosine quantification in urine, not serum or tumor microenvironment (TME). It does not address short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) at all. No consensus guidelines for absolute concentration measurement of inosine or SCFAs specifically in serum/TME were identified in this text. The physiological concentration ranges provided are urine-specific (creatinine-normalized) and cannot be directly extrapolated to serum/TME standards.
useful_material: This study developed and validated an LC-MS/MS method for quantifying adenosine, guanosine, and inosine nucleotides (mono- and triphosphate forms) in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), red blood cells (RBCs), and dried blood spots (DBS). The authors reported linearity ranges (e.g., 0.25–50 pmol/sample for inosine triphosphate), intraassay and interassay precision (%CV within 1.7 to 16%), and accuracy (%deviation within −11.5 to 14.7%). The method involved solid-phase extraction followed by dephosphorylation to molar equivalent nucleosides. The study identified specific stability issues, noting that triphosphate levels in DBS were approximately 26% lower compared to paired RBC lysates due to hydrolysis during drying/storage. It also highlighted environmental contamination as a critical factor for low-abundance nucleotides like ITP, requiring strict controls and adjusted lower limits of quantification.

useful_material.content: Developed and validated a targeted LC-MS/MS method for absolute quantification of inosine in human urine, following FDA and EMA bioanalytical guidelines (linearity, accuracy, precision, LOQ, stability).
useful_material.relevance: Demonstrates a rigorous standardized workflow for inosine quantification, providing methodological parameters (e.g., LOQ 0.040 µM, linearity 0.05–5 µM) that can inform serum/TME method development, though the matrix differs.

useful_material.content: Reported absolute concentration ranges of inosine in bladder cancer patients before and after tumor resection (e.g., 0.16 ± 0.12 µM/mM creatinine pre-surgery), normalized to creatinine.
useful_material.relevance: Provides empirical data on inosine physiological levels in a cancer context, supporting the feasibility of detecting inosine changes associated with tumor burden, even if urine levels do not directly equate to serum/TME concentrations.

useful_material.content: Sample preparation involved simple protein precipitation (methanol:water 1:1) and centrifugation without solid-phase extraction.
useful_material.relevance: Offers a simplified protocol example for nucleoside extraction that could be adapted for serum processing, reducing complexity compared to SPE methods.

useful_material: This study provides a detailed methodological example for the absolute quantification of inosine using LC-MS with stable isotope-labeled internal standards. The authors prepared an inosine calibration line in cell culture medium ranging from 100 pM to 1 μM (specifically: 100 pM, 1 nM, 5 nM, 10 nM, 50 nM, 100 nM, and 1 μM) and used [13C5]inosine or [15N4]inosine as internal standards for normalization. They validated the identification of inosine using accurate mass, isotopic distribution, and authentic standards. The study found that dendritic cells (DCs) release inosine in a FAMIN-dependent manner, with concentrations detectable in the low nanomolar range (e.g., differences observed around 5 nM), which acts via the A2A receptor to dampen T cell activation. The paper also describes the use of specific inhibitors and genetic variants to modulate these levels, establishing a causal link between enzyme activity and metabolite concentration.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this study to benchmark technical validation parameters (precision, accuracy, stability) for metabolite quantification methods in the review. Cite the PBMC vs. RBC concentration differences when discussing immune cell metabolic baselines. Continue searching for specific consensus guidelines or validated protocols for serum and tumor tissue samples, and for SCFA measurement methods, as these remain open gaps.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The specific success criteria for standardized measurement in human tumor microenvironment or serum remain unaddressed, as this study focused on blood cell lysates. There is no evidence of a consensus guideline or widely adopted standard for serum/tumor metabolite quantification in this text. Additionally, short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) are not covered, only purine nucleotides. The study represents a single-laboratory validation rather than a field-wide consensus.
useful_material: This study developed and validated an LC-MS/MS method for quantifying adenosine, guanosine, and inosine nucleotides (mono- and triphosphate forms) in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), red blood cells (RBCs), and dried blood spots (DBS). The authors reported absolute quantification ranges (e.g., inosine triphosphate 0.25–50 pmol/sample) with interassay precision ≤15% and accuracy within −11.5% to 14.7%. Key findings include significantly higher nucleotide concentrations in PBMCs compared to RBCs (5.6-fold for ITP) and instability of triphosphates in DBS samples (26% lower TP levels due to hydrolysis). The method requires solid-phase extraction and dephosphorylation steps to measure molar equivalent nucleosides, with strict controls for environmental contamination affecting low-abundance analytes like ITP.

This study investigated the mechanism by which gut microbiota enhance immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) therapy in colorectal cancer using mouse models. The authors identified inosine as a critical bacterial metabolite that promotes Th1 cell differentiation via the A2A receptor. They quantified absolute inosine concentrations in mouse serum and intestinal contents using untargeted metabolomics and fragmentation analysis (e.g., serum inosine in B.p. monocolonized mice was 26.16 ± 3.32µM; duodenal content was 66.13 ±14.23 µM). This material helps the gap by confirming that inosine is a quantifiable metabolite of interest and providing example concentration ranges in a biological system, demonstrating the feasibility of measuring absolute levels (µM) in serum and tissue contexts.

This study describes a validated high-throughput LC-MS/MS method for absolute quantification of thyroid hormones and metabolites in human serum, employing dansyl chloride derivatization to enhance sensitivity. The authors report detailed validation parameters including recovery (73–115%), precision (CVs 1.2–16.4%), and method limits of quantification (MQL) in pg/mL or ng/mL, adhering to European Analytical Guidelines (2002/657/EC). This provides a concrete methodological template for what a standardized absolute concentration measurement workflow looks like in serum, including sample preparation (protein precipitation, SPE, ultrafiltration), derivatization optimization, and matrix effect evaluation.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this material to document that the DIET trial has identified microbiome-mediated functional changes (bile acid biotransformation) associated with dietary intervention and ICB response. Cite the mouse FMT data as supporting evidence for the mechanistic link. In the gap analysis, note that specific taxa data and formal statistical mediation analysis of microbiome-to-clinical outcomes in humans are not detailed in this abstract, indicating a need to consult full-text publications or companion reports for complete mediation statistics.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This abstract does not list specific gut microbiome taxa compositional changes associated with the intervention in the human cohort, focusing instead on serum metabolite proxies for microbiome function. It does not explicitly report a statistical mediation analysis linking specific microbiome changes (taxa or functional pathways) to clinical outcomes (ORR, PFS, OS) in the human participants, though it links bile acid profiles to response in mouse models and notes numerical response differences in humans. There is no explicit statement that microbiome mediation data is pending or unavailable, but the reported data prioritizes metabolic profiling over microbiome sequencing results.
useful_material: This study reports secondary objectives from the DIET trial (NCT04645680), a randomized controlled feeding study in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). The authors found that a high fiber diet reduced unconjugated secondary bile acids and secondary-to-primary bile acid ratios in serum compared to control. The authors attribute these metabolic changes to reduced gut microbiota-mediated biotransformation of primary bile acids (cholic acid, chenodeoxycholic acid) into secondary bile acids (deoxycholic acid, lithocholic acid, ursodeoxycholic acid). In mouse avatar models using fecal microbiota transplant from trial participants, recipients of post-high fiber diet microbiota showed improved ICB response and decreased secondary-to-primary bile acid ratios. The authors conclude that dietary fiber modulates microbiome-mediated secondary bile acid synthesis linked to ICB response.

This study reports secondary objectives of the DIET trial (NCT04645680), a phase II randomized double-blinded dietary intervention in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). Patients were randomized (2:1) to a high fiber diet (30-50 g/d) or healthy control diet (20 g/d). The authors measured peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) using NanoString gene expression and CyTOF mass cytometry. Findings included decreased abundance scores of circulating macrophages, neutrophils, classical monocytes, and dendritic cells, alongside higher T cell activation gene signatures in the high fiber arm versus control within week 5-8. Human-to-mouse fecal microbiota transplant (FMT) studies using patient stool collected pre or post intervention revealed improved ICB response in mice receiving post-high fiber diet stool, suggesting microbiome-dependent benefits.

This study is a protocol publication for the DIET trial (NCT04645680), a randomized, double-blind, controlled feeding study comparing a high-fiber dietary intervention (50 g/day) to a control diet (20 g/day) in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade. The authors explicitly state in the Data Availability section that 'No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study,' which serves as an explicit statement that microbiome mediation data is currently pending/unavailable in this report (addressing success criterion 3). The text details the planned methodology to address the gap, including whole-genome shotgun sequencing of stool samples, metabolomic profiling (SCFAs, bile acids), and planned statistical analyses to explore associations between microbiome profiles and clinical outcomes (ORR, PFS).

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Search for subsequent results publications from the DIET trial (NCT04645680) specifically reporting microbiome outcomes and mediation analyses. Additionally, search for completed human dietary intervention trials in ICI-treated patients (other than DIET) that have published efficacy and microbiome mediation results. Use the trial design details from this protocol as a benchmark for evaluating the methodological rigor of any identified results papers.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This material does not report specific gut microbiome compositional or functional changes that resulted from the intervention, nor does it present statistical mediation analysis linking these changes to clinical efficacy (ORR, PFS, OS). While it confirms the trial plans to collect this data, the actual evidence required to determine if microbiome changes mediate clinical improvements is absent. The success criterion regarding an explicit statement that mediation data is pending is partially met by the 'no datasets generated' statement, but the primary gap of identifying the specific mediating taxa or pathways remains unresolved.
useful_material: This study is a protocol publication for the DIET trial (NCT04645680), a phase II randomized controlled feeding study in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). It details the study design comparing a high-fiber dietary intervention (50 g/day) versus a control diet (20 g/day). The authors explicitly state the primary objective is to establish effects on gut microbiome structure and function, and exploratory objectives include assessing associations with disease outcomes (ORR, PFS). The planned analysis involves longitudinal microbiome profiling (WGS sequencing) and statistical comparisons (linear mixed effects models, correlations) to explore associations between microbiome profiles and immunity/outcomes. Crucially, the Data Availability section states 'No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study,' indicating that results regarding microbiome mediation are not contained in this document.

This study investigated a 6-week whole-food-based high-fiber dietary intervention in 10 melanoma survivors, utilizing whole genome sequencing and microbial association network analysis (NetCoMi). It reported specific microbiome compositional changes, including increased community connectivity and increased centrality of known fiber-responsive and Short Chain Fatty Acid (SCFA)-producing taxa. The authors identified Ruminococcus bromii and Dorea longicatena as potential keystone species consistently showing increased centrality and associations with fiber-responsive taxa across different association statistics. These findings provide specific candidate taxa and functional groups (SCFA producers) that could be relevant for mediation analyses in ICI-treated populations.

This study reports an observational cohort analysis (n=128 for survival analysis, n=438 for profiling) in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). The authors found that higher dietary fiber intake was associated with significantly improved progression-free survival (PFS), while the use of over-the-counter probiotic supplements was associated with impaired response. The study included fecal microbiota profiling and parallel preclinical mouse models. In mice, low-fiber diet or probiotic use led to impaired anti-PD-1 treatment response and a lower frequency of interferon-γ–positive cytotoxic T cells in the tumor microenvironment. The authors state that gut bacteria modulate ICB response but the mechanisms underlying microbiota effects are presently unclear.

fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: Does the DIET trial (NCT04645680) or other human dietary intervention trials report specific gut microbiome compositional or functional changes that statistically mediate the observed clinical efficacy improvements in ICI-treated patients?
useful_material: This study reports specific gut microbiome compositional and functional changes associated with a medically supervised ketogenic diet (MSKD) intervention in humans. Taxonomical findings include significant enrichment of Akkermansia muciniphila (p=0.017931), Intestinimonas butyriciproducens (p=3.09E-05), Streptococcus thermophilus (p=1.15E-05), Roseburia hominis (p=3.94E-05), and Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus (p=7.28E-19) in the MSKD group compared to standard diet. Functional profiling identified increased phosphatidate metabolism (PWY-7039) and allantoin degradation (PWY-5705), with reduced L-ascorbate biosynthesis (PWY-6415). The authors note that Akkermansia muciniphila is linked to improved response to immune checkpoint inhibitors in existing literature. The study demonstrates that dietary intervention can produce sustained microbiome changes during cancer therapy, with MSKD patients showing better overall treatment responses and distinct microbiome profiles throughout therapy.

This study explicitly states in the Discussion section that 'Subsequent mediation analysis on gut microbiome was not able to be performed' due to limitations including small sample size for dietary data (N=34). It reports observational associations between baseline dietary patterns (specifically high fat and dairy intake) and gut microbiome composition (e.g., Firmicutes unclassified, Ruminococcaceae, Intestinimonas, Enterobacteriaceae) with ICI clinical outcomes (PFS, HPD status) in NSCLC patients. The authors note that while dietary patterns were associated with HPD, the sample size prevented statistical significance for diet-outcome links and precluded mediation modeling.

examples.conditions: 研究人群：NSCLC队列（n=20，一线治疗，PD-L1 TPS ≥ 50%，无既往抗PD-1暴露）；黑色素瘤队列（n=20，一线治疗，允许既往辅助抗PD-1但需停药>6个月）。干预措施：单次健康供体粪便微生物移植（FMT，口服胶囊）后紧接着启动ICI治疗。NSCLC组使用帕博利珠单抗（pembrolizumab）单药；黑色素瘤组使用纳武利尤单抗（nivolumab）联合伊匹木单抗（ipilimumab）。
examples.finding: 在NSCLC队列中，FMT联合抗PD-1治疗的客观缓解率（ORR）为80%（16/20），超过了预设的64%主要终点阈值。在黑色素瘤队列中，FMT联合抗PD-1加抗CTLA-4（双ICI）治疗的ORR为75%（15/20）。关于毒性信号，在黑色素瘤双ICI组中观察到严重不良事件（AEs）的发生率较高且起病更早：13名患者（65%）经历了3级或更高级别的AEs，其中腹泻或结肠炎是最常见的3级及以上AE（20%的患者），另有15%的患者出现心肌炎。严重毒性的中位起病时间为开始抗PD-1和抗CTLA-4治疗后40天，早于文献报道的60天。相比之下，NSCLC单药抗PD-1组无3级或以上AEs发生。
examples.use_in_review: 提供FMT联合免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）和黑色素瘤中的具体客观缓解率（ORR），以及双免疫检查点抑制剂（dual ICI）治疗下的毒性信号特征。

question_material.explanation: 该研究通过FMT-LUMINate II期临床试验评估了FMT联合ICI在两种不同癌症背景下的临床活性与安全性。结果显示，FMT显著提高了NSCLC患者对单药抗PD-1治疗的反应率（80%），并改善了黑色素瘤患者对双免疫检查点阻断（抗PD-1+抗CTLA-4）的反应率（75%）。然而，在黑色素瘤双ICI背景下，FMT联合治疗伴随着更高的免疫相关不良事件（irAEs）风险，特别是心肌炎和早期发作的严重毒性。这种毒性信号与特定供体来源的微生物群（富含Prevotella spp.）有关，且仅在双ICI背景下出现，而在单药抗PD-1背景下未观察到类似毒性。这表明FMT的安全性与特定的ICI治疗方案及供体微生物特征存在交互作用。

shared_outline.purpose: 读者应能准确区分不同实体瘤中微生物特征与ICI疗效的观察性关联强度，理解抗生素暴露的时间窗口依赖性及其对预后的量化损害，并能客观评估早期FMT/益生菌干预信号的证据等级与局限，为后续机制探讨与转化规划奠定事实基础。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物组与实体瘤免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗效的临床关联已在多项观察性队列中呈现一致性，特定菌属（如Akkermansia、Bifidobacterium、普拉梭菌）及高α多样性通常与改善的ORR、PFS和OS相关。然而，这种正向关联高度受肿瘤类型、治疗方案及宿主用药史修饰；围治疗期的广谱抗生素暴露会迅速破坏有益生态并显著缩短生存期，而质子泵抑制剂（PPI）的影响则相对较弱或具异质性。早期粪菌移植（FMT）等干预试验虽显示响应信号，但受限于小样本、单臂设计及安全性波动，尚无法替代标准治疗。本综述的核心论点是：微生物组-ICI关联具有生物学合理性与早期临床支持，但因果验证与临床转化需等待III期RCT结果及代谢物定量标准化。

shared_outline.purpose: 使读者掌握微生物组调节ICI疗效的三大机制路径及其分子靶点，清晰区分临床前因果验证与人类观察性证据的边界，理解UBA6作为肌苷作用替代标志物的代理性质，并明确当前绝对浓度测量缺口对转化医学的限制，从而建立从基础机制到临床转化的审慎评估框架。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物组主要通过代谢物-受体信号轴、免疫细胞启动/迁移及抗原模拟三条核心路径调节实体瘤免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗效；然而，当前人类证据高度依赖观察性关联或替代标志物（如UBA6表达），且肿瘤微环境（TME）中关键代谢物的绝对生理浓度尚未量化。尽管临床前模型已确立明确的因果链条，但人类验证仍受限于替代标志物代理与测量标准缺失，需待III期随机对照试验及标准化多层面闭合链条研究予以确证。

shared_outline.purpose: 掌握治疗方案、合并用药、宿主特征及肿瘤生物学如何作为关键调节变量修饰“肠道微生物组-免疫”互作；理解为何不同队列中微生物标志物与ICI疗效的关联存在显著差异；明确当前证据的适用边界、方法学局限及未来标准化需求。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物组对实体瘤免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗效的调节作用具有高度的情境依赖性。现有证据表明，特定菌属或代谢物的预测价值并非普适，而是受到治疗方案时序、药物暴露窗口与类别、宿主生理背景及肿瘤内在特征的强效修饰。本综述的核心论点是：解释Ch2中观察到的临床关联异质性，必须将微生物信号置于多维调节变量框架下；抗生素/PPI的负面影响高度依赖使用时窗与抗菌谱，饮食与年龄等宿主因素通过重塑基线菌群改变预测力，而肿瘤类型与分子亚型决定了微生物效应的可及性与方向。综述将严格区分观察性关联与干预性证据，避免将单一癌种或单一治疗背景下的微生物信号泛化，强调在评估疗效异质性时需纳入多维混杂与调节变量。

shared_outline.purpose: 使读者清晰掌握当前微生物组干预策略（FMT、LBP、益生菌、饮食/代谢物）在实体瘤 ICI 治疗中的临床证据等级、核心试验设计特征、关键安全性发现及方法学局限；理解为何现有阳性信号尚未转化为指南推荐；明确缺乏 Phase III RCT 确证的关键缺口及未来标准化研究的设计方向。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物组干预在实体瘤免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗中的临床转化仍处于早期探索阶段。尽管粪菌移植（FMT）、活体生物药（LBP）、益生菌及饮食/代谢物干预在多项 Phase I/II 试验中展现出恢复或增强抗肿瘤免疫的潜力，但现有证据高度依赖单臂设计、小样本队列及异质性极高的供体/菌株配方。截至 2026 年中，尚无已完成的 Phase III 随机对照试验确证其疗效；安全性信号（如双免背景下的严重 irAEs）与定植效率瓶颈进一步凸显了从观察性关联向因果性临床获益转化的鸿沟。本综述的核心论点是：微生物组干预具有明确的生物学合理性与早期临床信号，但其作为标准辅助疗法的地位需等待大规模、标准化、多中心 III 期 RCT 的确证，当前应严格区分概念验证信号与确证性疗效，并将资源优先投向供体筛选算法、菌株功能验证及代谢物定量标准化。

shared_outline.purpose: 为肿瘤科医师与转化医学研究者提供当前证据边界的批判性评估框架，使其能够区分稳健的观察性信号与过早的临床宣称，理解为何 III 期确证试验尚未完成，掌握代谢物定量与队列设计的方法学标准，并据此规划或解读未来的微生物组-ICI 临床研究。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物组与实体瘤免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗效的关联具有坚实的生物学合理性与早期临床支持，但因果验证与临床转化受限于三大方法学瓶颈：(1) 缺乏已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验确证生存获益；(2) 关键代谢物（如肌苷、短链脂肪酸）在人体血清或肿瘤微环境中的绝对浓度定量缺乏标准化协议与癌症特异性参考范围；(3) 因果推断受抗生素类别效应不一致、饮食-微生物组-疗效链条未完全证实及干预安全性风险等混杂因素制约。未来转化需依赖多层面闭合链条验证、供体/代谢物标准化流程及人工智能驱动的多组学精准分层。
